小5の新学期、クラスメイトから担任・木村の悪い噂の調査を依頼された龍村蒼太。証拠を押さえるためにドローンで追跡したら、家に入ったはずの木村が門の横からふたたび現れた!? さらに、木村がもっと増えることを予言する謎のメッセージがクラスのグループLINEに投稿されて……

クラスでも浮いた存在・守破リナに【ロンパ倶楽部】に勧誘されて、蒼太と謎めいた転校生・黒木遊歩は三人で増える木村事件の捜査を始める。

森晶麿

item.title: Every other day, 83-year-old Marilyn Tewa of the Hopi Tribe …
item.author: ProPublica (@propublica.org)
item.description:
Every other day, 83-year-old Marilyn Tewa of the Hopi Tribe loads buckets into her pickup and drives 5 miles to haul water. “That’s what keeps us alive,” Tewa said.

Four states stand in the way of a deal to give her community water.

item.title: "A concentration camp, in its most basic definition, is a pl…
item.author: Guardian US (@us.theguardian.com)
item.description:
"A concentration camp, in its most basic definition, is a place where a targeted civilian population, not necessarily accused of a crime, is detained and at least some of their basic rights are suspended," writes @jwashing.bsky.social.

"That’s precisely what’s happening in the United States today."
